variantInfo.name: Ent
notes: Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills; the level 101 Wilderness ent is the assigned target (the level 86 Woodcutting Guild ent does not count).
40% weakness to fire spells (added June 2025); ranged defence (+30) is its lowest melee/ranged defence.
After the ent is defeated its trunk can be chopped with an axe matching your Woodcutting level for noted logs, so a hatchet is useful.
Attacks with crush melee at a 4-tick speed.

locationComparison.name: Chaos Temple ents (Wilderness)
notes: 10 spawns total: 4 east of the Chaos Temple and 6 north of it, in the Wilderness.
Multicombat, cannon and safespot are not wiki-stated for these spots; conservative defaults are used.
The level 86 Woodcutting Guild ent is non-Wilderness and does not count for Krystilia.

taskNotes: Ents are a Krystilia (Wilderness) Slayer assignment: 35-60 per task, weight 5, no requirement.
slayerTargetId 258 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract: worklist id table, 252-305); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
wikiPageId is null (honest UNKNOWN - not captured at authoring time); sourced from https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ent.
Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills. The level 101 Wilderness ent (npc 6594) near the Chaos Temple is the target; the level 86 Woodcutting Guild ent (npc 7234) does not count.
The Wilderness ent is combat level 101 with 105 Hitpoints and grants 107.5 Slayer XP; defence level 75 with ranged its weakest defence (+30).
Ents have a 40% weakness to fire spells (added June 2025).
After defeating an ent, chop its trunk with an axe matching your Woodcutting level for noted logs; bring a hatchet.
No task extension unlock exists for Ents.
recommendedMethod: Travel to the ents near the Chaos Temple in the Wilderness. Exploit the 40% fire weakness with fire spells, or use ranged against their low ranged defence (+30). Chop each defeated trunk with a hatchet for noted logs. Bring only Wilderness-appropriate gear.
